title: Rosewood Desk Key
summary: Opens the rosewood desk in the House of Hope.

fields.Use: Opens the desk at X −6518, Y 2913 containing a Potion of Angelic Reprieve and a random Very Rare scroll. DC 10 Sleight of Hand can bypass the lock.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by the Theologist Eternal Debtor.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
